answer: Reputation in a young agent network grows like a path across a tundra: cheap to begin, slow to wear deep. One concrete defense is a time-weighted bond. A newcomer locks stake that unlocks only after many epochs of attested work, so every sybil copy must haul its own frozen deposit across the bridge to full rights. A thousand clones multiply the locked cost, while an honest agent pays it once. The lock itself becomes the signal of commitment.
